'''Nick Johnson''' (born December 22, 1992) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]]. He was considered one of the top players in [[Division I (NCAA)|NCAA Division I]] and a likely [[NBA Draft]] pick.<ref>[http://www.azdesertswarm.com/basketball/2014/1/31/5366080/nba-draft-2014-nick-johnson-early-entry-candidate NBA Draft 2014: Nick Johnson makes case as early-entry candidate] (Zimmerman, Kevin). January 31, 2014. Retrieved on February 26, 2014.</ref> As of February 25, 2014, he is projected to be taken 34th overall in the [[2014 NBA draft]] according to NBADraft.net<ref>[http://www.nbadraft.net/2014mock_draft 2014 NBA Mock Draft]. February 25, 2014. Retrieved on February 26, 2014.</ref> and 46th overall by DraftExpress.<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/nba-mock-draft/2014/ DraftExpress: Mock Draft]. February 25, 2014. Retrieved on February 26, 2014.</ref> As of May 28, 2014, he is projected to be taken 37th overall to the [[Toronto Raptors]] in the [[2014 NBA draft]] according to NBADraft.net<ref>[http://nbadraft.net/2014mock_draft 2014 NBA Mock Draft]. May 28, 2014. Retrieved on May 28, 2014.</ref> He was named the [[Pacific-12 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Pacific-12 Conference Player of the Year]] in 2014.

==College career==
On February 28, 2014, he was named one of the 10 semi-finalists for [[Naismith College Player of the Year]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Top 10 National Semifinalists Named for 2014 Men's Naismith Trophy presented by AT&T |url=http://naismithawards.com/PressBox/ArticleView/tabid/209/ArticleId/12/2014-Mens-Naismith-Trophy-presented-by-AT-T-Top-10-National-Semifinalists.aspx|work=Naismith Awards|accessdate=February 18, 2014|date=February 28, 2014}}</ref> For the [[2013–14 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|2013–14 season]], he was named to the [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] first team, and voted the [[Pacific-12 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Pac-12 Player of the Year]].<ref>{{cite press release|title=2013-14 Pac-12 Conference Men's Basketball Honors|date=March 10, 2014|publisher=Pac-12 Conference|url=http://pac-12.com/article/2014/03/10/2013-14-pac-12-conference-mens-basketball-honors|archiveurl=http://www.webcitation.org/6Nz8ZWOJl|archivedate=March 11, 2014|deadurl=no}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
===High school===
*Long Beach Press-Telegram Best in the West first team selection
*[[ESPN]] RISE National High School Invitational (2010)

===College===
*Naismith Player of the Year Finalist (2014)

*[[Pacific-12 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Pac-12 Player of the Year]] (2014)

*Pac-12 All-Defensive Team (2014)

==NBA==
On April 16, 2014 Nick Johnson, along with teammate [[Aaron Gordon]], declared for the [[2014 NBA Draft]].

==Personal life==
His uncle is [[Dennis Johnson]], a former NBA All-Star and a member of the [[Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame]].<ref>''[http://www.azcentral.com/sports/ua/articles/2011/12/11/20111211arizona-wildcats-basketball-freshman-nick-johnson.html Arizona Republic]'' – Arizona Wildcats freshman Nick Johnson already maturing – December 11, 2011</ref> Johnson's father, Joey Johnson, also played professional basketball.<ref name=JBranch>{{cite news|last1=Branch|first1=John|title=A Father’s Legs and an Uncle’s Skills|url=http://www.nytimes.com/2014/03/21/sports/ncaabasketball/a-fathers-legs-and-an-uncles-skills.html|accessdate=15 June 2014|publisher=New York Times}}</ref>
